notes.title: Indie action horror game "NIGHTMARE OPERATOR" will exhibit at EVO Japan 2025!
notes.content:
We will be exhibiting the latest build of "NIGHTMARE OPERATOR", which is currently in development, at EVO Japan 2025. NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is a TPS action horror game that combines lightning quick action with the ability to switch gun modes and unleash special moves by entering familiar commands inspired by fighting games. We humbly invite anyone in attendance to come and give this unique blend of systems a try!

■  EVO Japan 2025 Details
Dates; 2025/5/9 (Friday) ~ 2025/5/11 (Sunday)
Location: Tokyo Big Site East Halls 2~3
Event Site: https://www.evojapan.gg/ 

■ NIGHTMARE OPERATOR Steam® Page URL:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957360/NIGHTMARE_OPERATOR/

About NIGHTMARE OPERATOR

―― The year is 2036. Humanity has declined. Misha is a Public Safety Operator: a contractor for the Provisional Government tasked with hunting Youkai, and protecting the Quarantine City of Shin-Chiba. Within the haunted ruins of Tokyo, she unearths a mystery that could unmake what remains of civilization.

NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action-horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games.
